reply_text:
Gideon landed on 280 seats for Vantorre Group. I posted that as a reply to Nadia in #strategic-pod.

His July 1 update first said 300. He corrected it about five minutes later, because the 300 came from a staging tab that included sandbox logins from the May rollout. The production roster had 280 active seats as of Jul 1, and Ruth confirmed 280 in the thread.

His correction doesn't name Vantorre. It says "Nadia's old industrial account", and I took that to mean the same account. I said so in the reply. I also noted that the figure is from Jul 1, so Nadia should check a current source if she needs today's number.
